headline: Last session: Sensex surged 1,718 points to 81,028 while Nifty reclaimed 25,000, marking the best week in six years

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.

why: Bulls' party continued on D-Street as indices posted their best week in six years
Indian stocks bucked the global technology rout seen in international markets
Strong buying momentum was seen as Nifty 50 ended Samvat 2082 above 25,000
Financials and autos led the rally during the week's significant upward move
whatHappening: Sensex closed at 81,028 and Nifty at 25,030 in the last trading session
Gold prices extended their drop following stronger-than-expected US employment data
S&P 500 posted its biggest weekly drop since 2025 on AI trade worries
Bank holiday status for November 7 was checked across various states
summary: Indian markets ended the last session with significant gains as the Sensex surged 1,718 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,000. This rally concluded the best week in six years for domestic equities, driven by strength in financials and autos. Markets are currently closed for the weekend and will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.
